gloss: to use; to utilize; to make use of

definitions.gloss: to use; to utilize; to make use of
definitions.explanation: To employ something for a practical purpose or to one's advantage.

definitions.gloss: to take advantage of; to exploit
definitions.explanation: To use someone or something in a self-serving or manipulative way.

notes:
A very common verb meaning to use or make use of something. It implies purposeful, practical usage — often of facilities, services, or systems — rather than simply handling an object.

USAGE:
- Takes the particle ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{利用|りよう}する
- The noun form ⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧ is extremely common on its own, appearing on signs and in official documents
- Can have a negative connotation (sense 2) when the object is a person or someone's feelings

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{公共|こうきょう}{交通|こうつう}{機関|きかん}→公共交通機関：18106_koukyoukoutsuukikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{利用|りよう}する: to use public transportation
- ⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{利用|りよう}する: to use a service
- ⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{利用|りよう}する: to use a facility
- ⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{利用|りよう}する: to take advantage of an opportunity
- ⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧: available for use
- ⟦{利用|りよう}{者|しゃ}→利用者：03189_riyousha⟧: user
- ⟦{利用|りよう}{規約|きやく}→利用規約：29145_riyoukiyaku⟧: terms of use

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use — the most general word for using; {利用|りよう}する is more formal and implies purposeful use of resources or services
- ⟦{活用|かつよう}する→活用する：21424_katsuyousuru⟧: to make good use of, to put to practical use — emphasizes effective or skillful use
- ⟦{用|もち}いる→用いる：02314_mochiiru⟧: to use, to employ — literary or formal; used in writing more than speech
